text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired PD-8721: inference-queue-prod backlog breaching 18k, p95 3.6s p99 5.2s — autoscaler not keeping up
pagerduty: PD-8721 acknowledged by sanjay
sanjay: ack, pulling logs now, tagging maya
maya: on it, checking scale-controller and node provisioning
eli: seeing kubeapi 429s in the controller logs, looks like quota throttling
maya: yep, node provisioning requests are timing out, cloud errors: "quotaExceeded: cores" — possible region quota hit
ops-bot: Suggest manual scale to reserved pool 'dedicated-hotpath' if available
jordan: customer-impact: several active customers on realtime inference experiencing degraded latency; CS notified (ticket #C-4219)
sanjay: quick mitigation: switching traffic to smaller model variant (gpt-small-quant) for non-critical routes, ramping down batch size
maya: running manual spot-less spinup for 4 x n1-standard (non-preemptible) in us-west1 to tide over
maya: kubectl command I'm running:
```
kubectl -n infra patch deployment/scale-controller --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":3}]'
```
eli: controller logs tail:
```
E0312 14:07:22 scale_controller.go:348] failed scale up: 429 Too Many Requests from cloud api
E0312 14:07:45 provisioner.go:212] provisioning timed out after 120s
```
sanjay: temp reroute config to dedicated-hotpath:
```
redwood route update inference --from inference-queue-prod --to dedicated-hotpath --weight 30%
```
maya: started manual node spinup, ETA ~4m
ops-bot: note: enabling cache warmup for prefixes to reduce KV miss storm
eli: decreasing default batch size from 16 -> 8 for realtime route
jordan: CS update: telling affected customers we have degraded latency, switching to fallback model, ETA < 15m
sanjay: pager duty escalate if this isn't stable in 10m, @oncall-next please prepare for handoff
maya: 4 nodes came up, controller now reporting capacity +2, but queue still draining slow
maya: running a graceful restart of dispatcher to clear stuck inflight batches
```
dispatcherctl restart --queue inference-queue-prod --graceful 60
```
maya: dispatch logs show backlog processing rate jumped 2.8x after restart
eli: controller metrics now show scale events succeeding, cloud 429s reduced
sanjay: backlog down 18k -> 4.1k in 12m, p99 latency down to 1.6s
jordan: customer support: updated customers, no data loss, primarily latency impact
sanjay: marking PD as acknowledged, but leaving open until backlog < 500 and stable for 10m
pagerduty: PD-8721 status: acknowledged by sanjay, will auto-escalate if unacknowledged in 10m
maya: filing follow-up runbook update: add quota guardrails + proactive reserved capacity when cloud API 429s detected
sanjay: thanks team — handing off to eli for post-incident writeup and follow-up action items, i'll update the incident channel once postmortem is up
eli: will own postmortem, collecting traces and autoscaler metrics
customer-support: closing customer-facing ticket once backlog < 200 and latency stable
sanjay: done for now, moving to handoff, @jordan take lead if anything re-fires
jordan: copy, on call
